text:
By Erik Pedersen ,
1 hours ago Refresh for updates … The Visual Effects Society is handing out its 24th VES Awards tonight at the Beverly Hilton in Los Angeles, and Deadline is posting the winners in 26 categories live as they are announced. See the list below.
2026 Awards Season Calendar: Dates For Oscars, Guilds, Tonys & More
James Cameron’s blockbuster Avatar: Fire and Ash comes into the show with a leading 10 nominations , and it already has won four prizes, for Emerging Technology, Outstanding Model, Environment and CG Cinematography.
The 20 Century Studios threequel — the 16th-highest-grossing film of all time with more than $1.47 billion worldwide and counting — had its hopes of a category sweep ended when Apple Original Films’ F1 won for Outstanding Compositing & Lighting in a Feature. That happened to be one of two categories where Fire and Ash was competing against itself.
RELATED: The 25 Highest-Grossing Animated Films Of All Time At The Global Box Office
The first film prize of the Sklar Brothers-hosted ceremony — punctuated as usual by a classic rock soundtrack — went to Zoopotia 2 for Outstanding Environment in an Animated Feature. The highest-grossing Hollywood film in history came into the evening with five noms, tied for second-most with Netflix and Sony Pictures Animation’s KPop Demon Hunters and Disney/Pixar’s Elio .
Later, an 87-year-old movie won a 2026 VES Award — sort of — when The Wizard of Oz at Sphere took the trophy for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Special Venue Project.
Disney+’s now-wrapped Star Wars series Andor leads the TV field with two wins, for Outstanding Environment and Practical Effects. The Last of Us later took the trophy for Compositing and Lighting in an episode. The HBO drama was tied with Netflix’s recently wrapped Stranger Things and Apple TV/BBC Studios’ Prehistoric Planet: Ice Age with four VES noms each.
Elsewhere, BMW has won two VES Awards for its commercial titled “Heart of Joy: Meet Okto the Octopus.”
RELATED: 2026 Deaths Photo Gallery: Hollywood & Media Obituaries
Early on, the ceremony’s In Memoriam segment included VES professionals we lost during the past year including Roger Allers , Greg Cannom , Vince Zampella , Bob Burns, George Bloom, Loren Carpenter, Simon Cheung, Fabien Girodot, Jack Haye, Ian Jenkins, Jeremy Kendall, Tom Lynnes, Ralph S. Maiers, Con Pederson, Mike Schmitt and Dane Allen Smith.
This year’s VES Awards special honorees are prolific film and TV producer Jerry Bruckheimer and Wētā Workshop co-founder and COO Richard Taylor , who will receive the 2026 VES Lifetime Achievement Award and VES Visionary Award, respectively.
The Visual Effects Society and Movie Academy haven’t followed the same script much during the past decade-plus, with only five of winners of the marquee VES prize — Outstanding Visual Effects in a Photoreal Feature — going on to score the FX Oscar since 2013.
